faqs.question: What are your clinic hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 1pm. We are closed on Sundays.
faqs.not_for: appointment times for a specific patient, holiday hours, emergency extractions

faqs.question: Which dental insurance plans do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna and Bupa. For any other plan please call us on 555-0100 and we will check your coverage.
examples: what insurance plans do you take
faqs.not_for: what a plan covers for a specific treatment, payment plans or financing

faqs.question: Do you offer teeth whitening?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional whitening costs $350 for an in-office session and $180 for take-home trays.
faqs.not_for: side effects, whitening on crowns or veneers, insurance coverage of whitening

faqs.question: How do I book a new patient appointment?
faqs.answer: New patients can book online at example-dental.test/book or call 555-0100. Please bring photo ID and your insurance card to the first visit.
examples: how do i book an appointment
i want to make an appointment
how can i schedule a visit
faqs.not_for: rescheduling or cancelling an existing appointment, job applications

faqs.question: Is there parking at the clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes, free parking is available behind the clinic with the entrance on Oak Street.
examples: do you have a parking lot

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open daily 7am to 6pm, and on Sundays 8am to 2pm.
faqs.not_for: order pickup times for a specific order, holiday hours

faqs.question: Do you make custom cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we make custom birthday and wedding cakes. Send your design idea and number of guests through bella-bakery.test/custom and we will confirm the price by email.
examples: can i order a wedding cake
how do i order a custom cake
faqs.not_for: price quotes for a specific cake, cake ordering deadlines

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: We deliver within 10 km of the bakery for a flat fee of $8. We do not ship to other cities.
examples: can you deliver to my address
faqs.not_for: changing the address or time of an existing delivery, late deliveries

faqs.question: Do you have gluten-free or vegan options?
faqs.answer: We have gluten-free and vegan cakes and cookies. All items are made in a kitchen that also handles nuts, wheat and dairy.
examples: do you have gluten free options
faqs.not_for: ingredients of a specific item, severe allergy guarantees

faqs.question: How far in advance should I order?
faqs.answer: Please order custom cakes at least 3 days in advance, and wedding or multi-tier cakes at least 2 weeks in advance.
examples: how long does a custom cake take
how many days notice do you need
how early do i need to order
faqs.not_for: whether a specific date is still available

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: You can return a bike within 30 days of delivery if it is unused and in its original packaging. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving it.
examples: how do i return an item
faqs.not_for: damaged or defective items, returns of parts or helmets, return after a test ride

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the US. We also ship to Canada in 7 to 10 business days. Tracking is emailed when your order ships.
faqs.not_for: status of an existing order, shipping a bike for repair

faqs.question: What warranty do your e-bikes have?
faqs.answer: E-bike frames have a 5 year warranty, and motors and batteries have a 2 year warranty. Normal wear items such as tires and brake pads are not covered.
examples: how long is the battery warranty
faqs.not_for: water damage, damage from self-repair, comparing models

faqs.question: Do you service and repair bikes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we service and repair all bike brands. A basic tune-up is $80 and most repairs are done within 3 business days. Book through bike-shop.test/service.
faqs.not_for: repair prices other than a basic tune-up, return address for repairs, shipping repaired bikes

faqs.question: Can I book a test ride?
faqs.answer: Yes, test rides are free. Book a 30 minute slot at bike-shop.test/testride and bring photo ID.
faqs.not_for: returning a bike after a test ride, shipping a test bike
